batting.name: F du Plessis
batting.dismissal: c S Dhawan b V Pratap Singh

batting.name: M Vijay
batting.dismissal: c A Mishra b V Pratap Singh

batting.name: SK Raina
batting.dismissal: c AA Jhunjhunwala b A Mishra

batting.name: RA Jadeja
batting.dismissal: c KC Sangakkara b A Ashish Reddy

batting.name: A Ashish Reddy
batting.dismissal: c M Vijay b BW Hilfenhaus

balls.text: goes outside the off stump, slams it to long-on and they are able to come back for a second. Chennai have been able to get to 160 in their 20 overs.
pitched up to the bat, hits it inside out and goes to wide long-off for a couple. Turning out to be a decent over after the first ball wicket.
this is how you make them pay when they drop simple catches, smacked high up and that has cleared the deep mid-wicket fielder for a six!

full-toss and dropped! How can you drop so many catches in a tournament is beyond me. The batsman went for a pull, gets the bottom of the blade and it went high to the off side and Ankit Sharma has dropped a steepler.
outside the off stump, tries to pull it away but it goes only to the long-on fielder for a single. He is batting at eight for the first time in IPL.
length ball, wanted to pull him away, but the bottom-edge hits the stumps. This is a huge wicket as it brings a new batsman to the crease and also on strike!
short, slower and pulled away to the deep square-leg fielder for a run. He retains the strike, batting on 34.
slower one yet again but this time it is not only read well but it is a tad fuller as well and Dhoni smacks it over the bowler, for a four
gone, caught! was a slower one, tries to heave it away over mid-wicket, gets a top edge and that is easily caught by the DC captain.
poor ball, full-toss, but Dhoni is able to get it only up to deep square-leg, it seemed to have slipped from his hands. Sweaty palms again. Not called a no-ball, was a borderline call.
punched to the wide long-on region and the two men in the centre are quick enough to come back for the second run.
slower one, a really slower one and Dhoni wanted to pull it. He tried hard to wait, and he waited and he waited and then went for the stroke and then missed.
outside the off stump, punched to point and they are quickly off for a run
fuller this time, changing his length again, can only get it away to the long-on region for a single.
short ball, slower as well, Jadeja tries to play that up-and-over shot, misses.
low full-toss, outside the off stump, driven through the covers for a single.
fuller, outside the off stump and drilled through the covers, the deep point takes time to come in and they are able to come back for a second.
pitched right up to the bat, on the off-stump, wants to loft it over long-on but it goes on the bounce for a single
down the pitch, adjusts the length, punches it through to the deep point region for a single
right within the stumps, flicked away to mid-wicket and it is straight to the fielder.
plays it long-on and they rotate strike once again

on the pads, tried to flick it away, hits the pads, appeal for an lbw, but was clearly pitching outside, they go for a single and Jhunjhunwala throws it to the non-striker's end, misses. The batsman was way out of his crease.
slower one, outside the off-stump, wanted to play it away aggressively, checks the stroke and drives to the mid-wicket region for a single
pitched up, driven to the off side and straight to the fielder
short and he has actually taken his eye off, fends it away, takes no run
short from Steyn and swivel-pulled away for a single by Dhoni
shorter, pushes the batsman on his back-foot, jumps up and nudges it away to fine-leg for a single
short of length, punched through the covers for a single
short of good length, outside the off stump, gets it to cut away from the batsman, who misses it.
pitched up, outside the off-stump and that is brilliantly worked away to the deep point region for a couple. Opened the face well, to the left of point
quicker one, straighter and he tries to heave it away, goes through and the stumps are on the ground!
outside the off, very wide, but not called a wide
goes down the pitch and plays it the wide long-on region for a couple again
shorter, quicker, on the pads, tried to play it to the leg side, but hits the pads
full-toss out side the off stump, crashed through extra-cover, bit of a fumble allows them to come back for a second.
punched to the leg side and they are off for a single. And Dhoni comes back for a second, some really good running here
tries to force it through the covers and gets an inside edge for a single.
outside the off stump, punched through point and the third-man has to run to his left to tidy up, by which time Dhoni has called the new man for a couple
short again and Morkel works it round the corner, beats the short fine-leg fielder and he is away with a boundary
short, down the leg side, he goes under it and it is signalled a wide
short and pulled rather hard, but to the fielder at deep square-leg.
shorter, tried to cut it away, the ball does not arrive and it is tapped hard into the ground by the captain
pulled away and caught! It was shorter from the bowler and he went through with the shot after coming down the pitch, gets it off the middle but straight to the deep fielder, caught this time.
flicked away to the leg side for a single
full-toss and caught, but the batsman go through for a two. It was hit to the deep square-leg region and this time, it was pouched.
slower one, outside the off stump, driven to the off side, but it is no-ball, Free-Hit coming up.
short of good length, punched to the off side for a single
slower one, shorter and he wanted to pull it away, missed it, he was a couple of minutes early into that stroke.
outside the off stump, punched to the short third-man fielder for a quick single
pitched up, on the off stump, lofted over to deep mid-wicket for a single
on the middle stump, driven straight to mid-wicket and guess what? It is misfielded again!
this time on the middle, punched to the right of the backward point fielder, White, who picks and has a shy at the non-striker's end. 100 for CSK
goes down the pitch, the bowler shortens the length, cracks it through the covers and they are able to come back for a second
short of length, punched to the off side and they are off for a run
pitched up, driven to long-on and they cross over for a run
short outside the off-stump and it is hammered away through the covers for four!
another attempt to go down the track and gets a leading edge, goes all the way to sweeper where they get a couple. Bad throw almost results in an overthrow. Not.
short, cut and straight to the sweeper fielder.
comes down the track yet again, flicked it away to the mid-wicket for a single this time
on the legs, tapped to the mid-on region, the fielder was way back, the bowler ran after it but the two were able to complete a couple
pitched right up, Dhoni wanted to probably wanted to cut it, before going forward, defending, inside edge for a single
down the leg side, Dhoni wanted to flick it away, gets his pads on the way and goes fine for a couple of extras
shorter on the middle, googly, the batsman was a tad surprised by that and he misses, hits the pads.
goes down the pitch, tries to push it through the covers, is beaten by the flight, and turn, gets outside edge, there was a slip in place but wide of him and it goes through for three

goes for a heave, caught! Raina looked in good touch but he has now given it away, pitched up from Mishra, tried to clear the deep mid-wicket fence, failed to get the desired power and it goes straighter, to long-off fielder, who catches it, much to the relief of the Deccan fans.
shorter, probably a googly, punched and goes straight to the short cover fielder. And he does what they all have been doing, misfields.
goes down the pitch, punched it back to long-off, on the bounce to the fielder
gets his foot forward, defends, gets an outside edge through third-man for a couple
opens the face of the ball, gives himself room, drives through the covers and they are off for a single.
on the middle stump, defended back to the bowler.
full-toss, driven through extra-cover and it went straight to Cameron White at short cover, who misfields it!
on his pads this time, tries to work it to the leg side, misses the bat I think, hits the pad and they are off for a single
on his pads, shorter and punched to mid-wicket for a single
full-toss, goes down the track and is that dropped too, difficult chance for the bowler to his right, but that is the third miss
shorter, googly, waits for the ball and cuts it away for a single
on the middle stump, wanted to heave it away, but gets a bit of an inside edge to deep square for a single
floated up, driven to extra-cover for a single
was that dropped? Tipped over the bar? du Plessis went down the wicket, went for the big shot, goes to the wide long-on region, hits his fingers and goes over.
pulls his length back, Raina nurdles it to square-leg and they get a single
pitched up to the batsman, gets his pad out, drives to long-off for a single
shorter to Raina, who wants to pull it away, but misses, flicks his pads on the way to the wicket-keeper
quicker this time, played away to the leg side for a single.
goes down the pitch yet again, it was floated up in the air and driven to the right of the bowler, who fields well.
another one from round the wicket, pitched up, takes it on the full but drives to the left of the bowler
outside the off-stump, flighted and driven but straight to the fielder
shorter from the bowler, flat bats it to long-on for a single
on the pads, tucked away to the square-leg region for a single. End of a good Powerplay for the home team.
short of good length, outside the off stump, wanted to punch it through the covers, goes straight to the fielder
and on the middle this time, pitched up and dabbed away to deep square-leg
flicked away rather well, through the fine-leg region, the short fine-leg was up in the circle and this was easy pickings. That is another ball down the leg side from DC
way down the leg-side and Patel has to dive to his left to stop it, does a good job but it is a wide.
good length, on the off stump, du Plessis hits it on the up and it was in the air for some time but safe, through the covers for a couple
on the middle, short of length, driven to short mid-wicket for the fielder to pick up
and another one! A proper short ball, bouncer, Raina is in that kind of a mood that he seems to be going for everything, gets it over the fine-leg region for the second six of the innings.
not too short, but short enough for Raina to heave it away over deep mid-wicket for a six!

and Amit Mishra has dropped another one. Came out of the crease, wanted to play it aggressively, gets the top edge, goes to the third-man region and he needed to move forward, he did, gets hands to it and spills it. Sorry but he should have taken this.
short of length, punched to the off side for a single.
flat-batted it over mid-on for a four. He was attempting this one before as well but the pace this time is much easier to play, almost played it early, but is able to get it over the fielder
and at the other end, the bowling is much easier, du Plessis is able to move towards the off side, and it worked away to the deep mid-wicket region for three.
short ball, on the chest and Raina jumps disconcertingly yet again, pushes to the leg side near the stumps
Gives himself some room, wanted to cut it away, but it took off, don't think it hit the top-edge, beats the keeper, chipping his fingers through to the fence.
another short ball, Raina was sent back on his back foot yet again, face of the bat opened and it loops up towards point, but not to the fielder
shorter, quicker, 144.0 km/hr, defended on the back foot
jumps out yet again, ball's outside the off stump, almost in the air back to the bowler, goes to mid-off
too much on his pads, trying to cramp him but du Plessis had all the time to time it through the leg side for a four. Beat the deep square-leg fielder
outside the off stump, jumps out, opens the bat face and it is tapped away to the third-man fielder
outside the leg stump, tries to flick it through short fine-leg, but hits his pads and they are off for a single, leg-bye
pitched up, angling across, defended away to the off side.
short from VP Singh and Raina wanted to pull it away, misses the shot and it goes through to the wicket-keeper.
gone, caught! Four and out! It was short and Vijay wanted to pull it away, gets a top edge and it goes to the third-man fielder, Mishra holds on to this catch this time!
width and murder! Vijay has come back into the side and immediately shown form, outside the off stump and it has been punched over cover for four. It was a shot in much anger!
this time he drifts on to his pads again and Vijay caresses it through mid-wicket, the ball looks to be going to the fence but holds up yet again. The batsmen are able to take three.
short of length, outside the off stump and punched to the off side for no run
on the off-stump, does not pitch it up, punched to the off side and goes to the extra cover fielder.
short of length, Vijay defends it back to the bowler
on the middle, swinging away, almost squaring up Vijay, leading edge to the off side
pitched outside the off stump, swinging away, driven through point and the third-man gives chase, restricts them to two. Slow outfield
fuller and defended to the leg side off the front foot
this time on the middle stump, tapped to the leg side for a single
down the track and driven through extra-cover for four. It was shorter in length, probably after he stepped out but well controlled
pitched right up again, on the middle, driven to the off side for no run
drifting on his pads, plays it away to deep square-leg for a single
pitched right up, fullish, on middle, driven back to the bowler
full-toss and dabbed to the point fielder for a single, that is the end of that and Chennai have broken their three-match drought with a win!
full pitched, driven to long-off for a single, 12 off one needed
gone, caught! Tried to slash it away, goes in the air, and Murali Vijay ran to his right and catches it well.
full-toss, drilled back to the bowler, for a couple of runs
edged and that goes to fine third-man, but the fielder is just where they need him to be, and there is only a single
flicked away for four. Goes outside the off-stump and mows it to the fine-leg fence for a four. The fielder was up inside the circle.
low full-toss, outside the off-stump, Christian was trying to heave it away to the leg side and gets only a single.
poor, poor ball, full-toss, on the pads, he gets a bit of a bat on it and with the fine-leg up inside the circle, it goes for a four
Full ball, the new batsman tries to drill it away, gets a bit of the bat and they are off for a single. Bravo tries to effect a run-out but misses the stumps and Christian is home.

block-hole, run-out, is it? Yes, it is. It was taken on the full, driven through the covers, they went for the second and it looked like Christian was going to the danger end, but the throw came at White's end, he was short of the crease, only marginally, when Dhoni broke the bails.
outside the off-stump, way, way outside and that is called a wide. Easy decision.
yorker-length, converted into a full-toss, but drilled only to long-on for a single
pitched full, driven back to the bowler, fielded and there is no run.
hoicked away to the leg side, spotted late by the fielder at the fine-leg and it rolls over for a four, 18 from that over and that Chargers have a chance here after all!
outside the off-stump, was giving himself room, but leaves it because it was too wide
over long-off this time, White has taken Jadeja on and he has succeeded in getting the runs this over, that were required.
shot, six! That was not hit effortlessly, in fact, one almost thought he had mistimed it, tired stroke and it goes over long-on!
swept away for a single, leg bye called
pitched full and driven to the extra-cover for a single
full-toss, down the leg-side, poor ball and should have been sent to the fine-leg fence, goes only to the short fine-leg fielder for a single
smashed powerfully back over the bowler's head and that gives no chance to either of the two fielders on the fence, straight back, to move.
fullish ball, outside the off stump, driven to mid-wicket for a single
tried to paddle it over the short fine-leg, there is a loud appeal for a caught-behind, but umpire gives it not-out. Missed the bat completely
drilled down the ground for a single to long-on
outside the off stump, goes for a slog to deep square-leg, but to the fielder, gets a single
goes down the pitch but can only gets it down the ground for a single.
goes down the pitch, shorter and that is driven to he sweeper fielder.
drilled back and it results in another of those run-outs at the non-striker's end. Misfield allows a single
steps away to the leg side, makes room, drives to long-off for a single
goes down the pitch but hits it back to the bowler.
goes outside the leg stump and tries to force it through the off side, goes to the extra cover fielder
slower one, outside the off stump, was a bit of a surprise for the batsman, waited but failed to get any timing on it.
pitched up, driven to long-off for a run, rate's still 11.
outside the off stump, cut away to the third-man fielder for a single
chipped and with some power! That has easily crossed the long-on fielder, gone for the maximum!. On the pads and he wasted no time there.
opens the face of the bat, to the left of point and they are off for a single, third half-century for Cameron White in four innings.
flicked away to the leg side, deep square-leg fields and only a single results.
on the middle stump, punched to the off side for only a single.
quicker on the middle stump, driven to short mid-wicket
fuller ball, defends on the front foot back to the bowler
shorter, quicker, on the pads, White plays it away to deep square-leg for a single
pitched right up to the bat, on the leg-stump, driven to long-on
pitched up to the bat, pushes it to long-on for a single
widish again, this time pitched right up, driven to long-off for a single
outside the off stump, tries to cut it away, slightly widish, kept low too and missed. White was looking for a wide. Wasn't coming
short of length, off the back-foot and punched to the off side for a single
length ball, hits the bat hard, punched back into the ground and goes nowhere
shorter from Morkel, tries to cut it away off the first ball he faces, misses it and it goes through to the keeper.
opens the face of the bat, taps it away to the third-man for a single
gone, caught! Off the back foot, he tries to punch it to long-off but Raina dived to his right and pulls out a superb one-handed catch!
on the middle, he walks across to the line of the ball and taps it away for a single to deep square-leg
reverse-swept away from White, not too aggressively hit, just dabbed away through short fine-leg
down the track yet again and again, it hits his pads, pops up to the on-side and they take a leg-bye
goes down the track and it hits his pads
pitched up, driven to short cover
outside the off stump, pitched full up, driven to deep point to open his account.
slower one, driven to the long-off for a single

run-out, and how was that! It was drilled back to the bowler, absolutely smashed and Bravo had no chance to catch it, but it hits him and deflects it on to the stumps by some quirk of fate, with Dhawan a few yards away. It hit his foot, Bravo was falling over in front as well!
bouncer attempted, pulled away to deep square-leg for a run
shorter, tries to pull it away, straight to mid-wicket
goes down the pitch, tries to whack it through the covers, but straight to the extra-cover fielder
outside the off-stump, better length, and misses the outside edge of the bat
a very poor ball, down the leg-side and White only looked at it go. Dhoni did a good job getting in its way.
short ball, and that has been cut away for a four by White, excellent batting from the former Australian T20 skipper!
shorter ball, pulled it away for a single
turn and a bit of a bounce, beats the outside edge of the bat
driven down the ground this time for a single
driven back and fielded well by the bowler
on the front foot, White pushes it to the off side and they are off for a single.
shorter, cut away to deep point for a single
almost spoons it to long-on, but goes on the bounce for the long-on, fields well
punched off the back foot for a single
inside out and he has smacked it over the extra-cover region for a four! Beats the sweeper fielder very easily
down the pitch, gets the inside edge to fine-leg, and they run rather well for a second. 50-run stand off only 39 balls, doing this well here.
opens the face of the bat and they are quickly off for a single
this time it is short, the carrom ball, White rocks back and smacks it wide long-off, that should have been stopped, but poor fielding from Bravo gets them a four!
goes down the track, shortens the length, flicks to mid-wicket again
from outside the off stump, flicked away to the leg side, to mid-wicket
pitched up, tries to sweep it, hits the top-edge and then on to the chin, hits hard.
huge appeal for a catch, he tried to play it away to the leg side, balloons up and Dhoni holds it. Not out given
pitched up, driven to extra-cover, Raina slides to his right and fields, throws it to the non-striker's end, misses both, the bowler and the stumps and they are off for an overthrow.
short of length and nudged off the back foot to deep square-leg for a single
on the middle, pitched up, tapped to the leg side for a single.
tapped away to the left of the bowler, who runs to mid-on to field that one, restricts them to one.
quicker one, outside the off stump, punched to long-off for a single
very short from Jakati, and it is forced away to the deep square-leg for a single
shorter ball, easily played away to the leg side for a single, seven off the last over of the Powerplay.
he shortens the length this time, punched to the long-on fielder for a single
smoked over the bowler's head and it goes into the boundary on the bounce. An excellent shot!
on the off stump, defended back to the bowler
goes down to the pitch of the ball, drives to long-off for a single
shorter, goes on to the back foot, punched to the covers
another poor ball from Bravo, drifts on the right-hander's pads this time and White needs to only get some bat on it, easily beats the short fine-leg fielder.
flicked away to the deep square-leg fielder for a single
a bit of an in-dipper, on the off-stump, coming in to the bat, gets an inside edge and they get a single
slower one and has been tonked over mid-on for four! It was pitched right up to the bat and White has deposited him to the fence.
adjusts his line, outside the off-stump, cuts it through to third-man for a single
poor ball, down the leg side, was short enough to flick it to fine-leg, the fielder was up in the circle and it goes for a four
shot, a very good shot, length ball and punched off the back foot to the right of the fielder at mid-off for three.
full on his legs, wanted to play it over the bowler's head, gets a bit of an inside edge and it goes to the deep square-leg fielder
punched to the point region where Faff misfields a tad and they get one
length ball, White goes on to the back foot and opens the bat away for the third-man to come into the picture
short of length, on his legs, worked away to short fine-leg for a single
flicked away and the fielder at fine-leg lost it in the lights, he did not go for the catch and in the end, had to dive to stop what was going straight to him.
shortens his length, on the off-stump, pushes it to the point region
over-pitched and driven through extra-cover for a four!
on the legs, forced through the leg-side, the dive from square-leg does not help and they get a couple
outside the off stump, punched to the off side and they wanted a single, White wasn't having any of it.
driven to the mid-on fielder and they go for a quick one
outside the off stump, guided through the point region for a single to third-man
off the back foot, defended on to the off side
dropped! It is catching on! Pitched up to the bat, and White chips it back to the bowler , simple catch and the bowler has spilled it.
inside edge and Patel is bowled again, second game in a row! Went down the pitch in an attempt to up the scoring, gets the edge and the leg-stump is grounded.
short of good length, punched back to the bowler off the back foot
on the leg-stump this time, pitched fuller and driven to the mid-on for a single
goes through the covers for four, and it was actually through the fielder, driven, hits the edge of the practice wicket and jumps way over Jadeja at point!
in-swinger, swinging a tad too much into the batsman, he tries to play it through the leg side, misses the bat and there is an lbw appeal. Drifting down the leg side.
outside the off stump and driven through the covers, beats the in-field and Bravo chases it down well, fields through a slide and saves a run
defended on the back foot, back to the bowler.
outside the off stump, on the good length, tries to drive it but goes to the point fielder
short of length, goes on the back foot, pushes it to the leg side for a quickly taken single
outside the off-stump, a bit of bounce and tries to go for the cut, gets an inside edge and goes on the bounce to the wicket-keeper
